label: D2 after a2->S2 common, following a rewarded a2->S2 trial, mid-episode (trials 10-40)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), and essentially only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition (in_action=2, in_state=2: 11944/11945 active steps), after a rewarded previous trial (prev_reward=1, 100%) that was itself not a1 and not rare (i.e. a repeated a2->S2 rewarded streak). All variables are observed at D2 (action/state/common known from D2). Activation is confined to episode trials ~10-40 (98% of mass in ep_bucket 10-49, zero after trial 50), and favours episodes where S2 is good (80% of mass). Value head is in its top bin on all active steps. Within a window, activation is largest on the first such trial and decays across consecutive a2->S2c trials (e.g. 1.0, 0.87, 0.44, 0.25, 0.15), suggesting a slowly saturating/time-dependent component. Never fires on a1 choices, S1 states, rare transitions or prev_reward=0. Recall/mass recall ~0.95/0.97 on dev but precision only ~0.43: within the episode window many qualifying steps are silent, apparently controlled by the decaying streak/episode-time dynamics that a boolean predicate does not capture.
